claims: NASA currently projects the Artemis III mission to launch in 2027.
The Artemis II flight is scheduled for 2026.
Artemis III is designed to test critical rendezvous and docking capabilities in low Earth orbit with commercial landers from SpaceX and Blue Origin.
Artemis III is to prepare for a subsequent crewed lunar landing on Artemis IV in 2028.
Artemis III mission goal is to test new Extravehicular Activity (xEVA) suits, integrated life support, and propulsion systems in orbit.
Artemis III will utilize commercial landers.
Artemis III partnerships include SpaceX (Starship HLS) and Blue Origin.
The crew for Artemis III will launch from Kennedy Space Center, Florida, on the Space Launch System (SLS) rocket.
The timeline for Artemis III was updated in early 2026.
The Artemis III timeline was updated to focus on ensuring the readiness of essential technologies for long-term exploration
